# Vendored browser dependencies

These minified browser bundles are served from the same origin as PDF Blade to reduce third-party network failures.

- Mozilla PDF.js 3.11.174 — Apache-2.0
- pdf-lib 1.17.1 — MIT
- JSZip 3.10.1 — MIT or GPL-3.0-or-later

Source distributions:

- https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v3.11.174
- https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib/releases/tag/v1.17.1
- https://github.com/Stuk/jszip/releases/tag/v3.10.1
